Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.store

Class TerminologyStoreWriter

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.terminology.store.TerminologyStoreWriter
public class TerminologyStoreWriter extends Object
Writes terminology store tables using Spark and Delta Lake. Import code uses this to persist the store; each table is written as a Delta table under the store root. Per-version content is replaced atomically through Delta's replaceWhere, so concurrent readers pinned to an earlier snapshot always see a consistent version.
Author:
John Grimes

    • replaceWhere

      public void replaceWhere(@Nonnull Dataset<Row> data, @Nonnull String tableName, @Nonnull String condition)
      Atomically replaces the rows of a table that match a condition, leaving all other rows untouched. The supplied data must satisfy the condition. This is the mechanism for re-importing a single code system version without disturbing other versions.
      Parameters:
      data - the replacement rows, all of which must match condition
      tableName - the table name (a TerminologyStoreSchema constant)
      condition - a SQL predicate selecting the rows to replace (for example "system_version_id = 'abc'")

    • writePartitionedBySystemVersion

      public void writePartitionedBySystemVersion(@Nonnull Dataset<Row> data, @Nonnull String tableName, @Nonnull String systemVersionId)
      Writes a content table partitioned by system_version_id, replacing an existing version's partition atomically or creating the table on first write. All rows must belong to the given system version.
      Parameters:
      data - the rows to write, all belonging to systemVersionId
      tableName - the table name (a TerminologyStoreSchema constant)
      systemVersionId - the code system version identifier the rows belong to

    • upsertManifestEntry

      public void upsertManifestEntry(@Nonnull ManifestEntry entry)
      Adds or replaces a single manifest entry, keyed by canonical URL and version, atomically. The entry is appended when the manifest does not yet exist and replaces the matching entry otherwise, leaving other entries untouched.
      Parameters:
      entry - the manifest entry to upsert
